events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: What's the story, morning glory? It's Liam Gallagher's 54th birthday! We're celebrating the iconic frontman's biggest tunes today.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the UK single release of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. Still as powerful and poignant as ever.

events.title: First iPod announced 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple co-founder Steve Jobs announced the very first iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket,' on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when you had '1,000 songs in your pocket'? The original iPod was announced 25 years ago this month, revolutionising how we listened to music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy franchise which officially began with the premiere of 'Dr. No' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showed the world a new, more mature side to the Fab Four.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his passing. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.
